title: Designated aisle seats.
officialText:
At least five percent, but not less than one, of the total number of aisle seats provided shall be designated aisle seats, shall be the aisle seats located closest to accessible routes, and shall comply with ICC A117.1, including
Section 802.8 (Designated Aisle Seats).
Exception: Designated aisle seats are not required in team or player seating serving areas of sport activity.
